'''2014 Alderaan Regionals Jeffrey W LS Rebel Gunrunner''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey W]] at [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Rebel Gunrunner]]
* '''Username:''' Istagrem
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
